chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan ibn 'Ali, from Aban, from Abi al-'Abbas, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
The boy is not subjected to the hadd punishment when he has intercourse with a woman, but the man is subjected to the hadd punishment when he has intercourse with a young girl.

key_terms.الرَّجُلُ: an adult man who bears legal responsibility
key_terms.الصَّبِيُّ: a young boy who has not reached legal maturity
key_terms.يُحَدُّ: to have the prescribed hadd punishment applied

ai.seo_question: Is a minor given the hadd punishment for zina in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning the application of the hadd punishment in cases involving a minor versus an adult male. It distinguishes between legal responsibility on the basis of maturity and liability under penal law.
